content: Devit capa, phungdeikung Jerusalem siangpahrang ni a dei e lawk teh,

content.text: Ahrawnghrang doeh, ahrawnghrang doeh.
Bangpueng hai ahrawnghrang doeh.
Kanî rahim vah tami ni a tawksak e pueng
bang hawinae maw kaawm.
Se buet touh aloum teh se alouke bout a tâco.
Hatei, talai teh a kangning.
Kanî a tâco teh bout a khup.
Hatei, a tâconae koehoi bout bout a tâco.
Kahlî haiyah a kâheinae koe lah
bout bout a kâhei.
Tuipuinaw a lawng teh talîpui dawk koung a kâcu eiteh kawi hoeh.
Talîpui teh a lawngnae koelah bout bout a ban.
Bangpueng hai tami ni dei thai hoeh totouh patangnae a kâhmo .
Mit ni a khet eiteh hmawt thai hoeh.
Hnâ ni a thai eiteh boum thai hoeh.
Hno kaawm tangcoung e hai bout kaawm hane hoi a kâvan.
Atu sak e hai bout sak hane hoi a kâvan.
Kanî rahim vah hno katha awm hoeh.
Khenhaw! hno katha buet tabang ao maw awm hoeh,
ayan vah yo kaawm tangcoung e doeh.
Ayan kaawm boi e hnonaw ouk pahnim thai awh.
Ka tho hane naw hai ka tho hane naw ni bout a pahnim awh han.

content: Kai, phungdeikung, Jerusalem khopui dawk Isarel siangpahrang lah ka o nah,
Kanî rahim vah sakyoe e pueng thoumthainae lahoi pakhingpalang lungthin ka tawng. Cathut ni taminaw koe khoram sak nahanelah a patangpalai sak.
Kanî rahim e hnosak e pueng ka hmu toe. Bangpueng ahrawnghrang doeh. Kahlî ka man e hoi doeh a kâvan.

content.text: Ka longkawi e teh palan thai hoeh.
Kamko e hno teh touk mahoeh.

content: Kama hoi kama ka kâdei e teh, kai teh Jerusalem kauknaw pueng hlakvah ka talue, ka lung a ang, ka lungthin ni lungangnae hah alawkpui lah a kamtu.
Lungangnae hoi pathunae, polainae pakhingpalang ka tawn. Hot naw haiyah, kahlî man e patetlah doeh ao.
Lungangnae apap nah, lungreithainae a pap. Thoumthainae apapnae koe lungmathoenae hoe a pap.
